description: Multi-line text input with label, help and error.

howToUse: Use it for text that can take more than one line: description, comment, message.
Give it a `label`, and a `hint` with the limit or the tone expected ("Up to 500 characters").
Show `error` below the field, saying how to fix it.
alternatives: A message in a chat, with send and attachments: IntentComposer.
